author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! One of the biggest games has been announced and has a set release date finally allowing you to pre-order, except it doesn't actually come in a format you can own. GTA 6 is a game I'm excited for but the way that Rockstar Is handling this release is concerning and I hope they change course. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: I'm Still Mad At Rockstar Games And GTA 6...
